_comment2: Inn scene. Fei grooms herself, Iris reacts, panda fur cosmetic is unlocked.

speaker: Narrator
text: The inn is quieter at this hour. Most of the party has found a corner to collapse in. Fei, apparently, has found a mirror.

speaker: Narrator
text: She has produced a wide-toothed comb from somewhere and is working through the thick black-and-white fur at her shoulder with the focus of someone performing surgery. The fur, in the low lantern light, looks almost luminous.

speaker: Iris
text: ...What are you doing?

speaker: Fei
text: Grooming.

speaker: Iris
text: I can see that. I meant — why here? In the common room?

speaker: Fei
text: The light is better here. The mirror in my room points at a wall.

speaker: Iris
text: That's... a fair point, actually.

speaker: Narrator
text: Iris watches for a moment longer than she probably intends to. There is something almost hypnotic about it — the rhythm of the comb, the way the fur separates and settles.

speaker: Iris
text: Your fur is... it's very — I mean, the pattern is unusual. I've never seen colouring like that up close.

speaker: Fei
text: Panda. Both sides. My mother used to say we were descended from mountain spirits, but I think she was just being poetic.

speaker: Iris
text: It's beautiful.

speaker: Fei
text: It is a lot of maintenance.

speaker: Iris
text: Still. Worth it, I think.

speaker: Narrator
text: Fei glances at Iris in the mirror. A small pause.

speaker: Fei
text: Would you like to try?

speaker: Iris
text: I — what?

speaker: Fei
text: The comb. It is easier with two people for the back sections. And you have been staring long enough that it seems polite to offer.

speaker: Iris
text: I wasn't staring.

speaker: Fei
text: You were staring.

speaker: Iris
text: ...Okay. A little.

speaker: Narrator
text: Iris takes the comb, tentatively. Fei turns so her back is toward her and says nothing further, which Iris eventually interprets as an invitation to proceed.

speaker: Iris
text: It really is something. The way it catches the light...

speaker: Fei
text: My grandmother called it her inheritance. The mark that something remembered us when we forgot ourselves.

speaker: Iris
text: That's beautiful.

speaker: Fei
text: It is also just fur.

speaker: Iris
text: It can be both.

speaker: Narrator
text: Fei considers this. A small sound — not quite a laugh, but close.

speaker: Fei
text: Yes. I suppose it can.

speaker: Narrator
text: They stay like that for a while. The inn settles around them. Nobody else comes in.

notification_text: Panda Fur style unlocked for Fei!

speaker: Narrator
text: The inn is quiet. Nothing in particular happens.
